items.name: uiset
items.title: UISet
items.description: The UISet root: skins, a key color, and sound and haptics for every UI SDK component inside it.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button in solid, outline and ghost variants, and one that asks for a second press.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on and off switch, with its thumb in place.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A range slider whose track, fill and named thumbs render in one line.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: One choice among a few, in a row with a moving indicator.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Choose from a list in a popup; the trigger shows what's chosen.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label, control, description and error, connected for screen readers.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window for a focused task, closed by Escape or its close button.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Panels that share one space, switched by a row of tabs.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Sections that open one or many at a time.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: A confirmation that interrupts, with agent confirmation built in.

items.name: autocomplete
items.title: Autocomplete
items.description: Free text with suggestions as you type.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person's image with initials as the fallback.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking dates, ready to use as is.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slides with previous and next controls and keyboard paging.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox with its check mark, and checkbox groups.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One section that shows and hides.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color picker
items.description: Area, hue and alpha sliders, swatch and hex input, ready to use.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Search a list and choose one or several.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable list of commands, for palettes and launchers.

items.name: date-input
items.title: Date input
items.description: A date typed segment by segment, in the reader's locale.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A date field with a calendar popup.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge.

items.name: file-input
items.title: File input
items.description: Choose, drop or paste files, with validation.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: A preview that opens on hover or focus.

items.name: image-cropper
items.title: Image cropper
items.description: Crop, zoom, rotate and flip an image.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field, with clear button and groups.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A label for any control.

items.name: listbox
items.title: Listbox
items.description: An always-visible list to choose from.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Actions from a button or a right click, with submenus.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: An application menu bar.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A measurement within a range, as a bar or a ring.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: Site navigation with panels.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number input
items.description: A number field with named step buttons, ready to use.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: One-time code
items.description: A one-time code field with a slot per character.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page links with named previous and next, ready to use.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password input
items.description: A password field with a show toggle.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A panel beside its trigger.

items.name: preferences
items.title: Preferences
items.description: User preferences applied as data attributes and saved.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress of a task, as a bar or a ring.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: Radio groups with their dot, and cards that choose an option wherever you press.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: A star rating, ready to use.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels you resize by dragging or with the keyboard.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: Styled scrolling, plus ScrollBox with the parts in place.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A line between content.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text that can grow with its content, and a count of its limit.

items.name: time-input
items.title: Time input
items.description: A time typed segment by segment.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Events in order, with markers and a connecting line.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Notifications, with a Toaster ready to render once.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Pressed buttons and toggle groups.

items.name: token-input
items.title: Token input
items.description: Text mixed with tokens for files, people or tags.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Buttons and toggles with one tab stop.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint on hover or focus.

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: A hierarchy you expand and select.

items.name: trigger-menu
items.title: Trigger menu
items.description: Suggestions after @, / or # in a text field.

items.name: waterfall
items.title: Waterfall
items.description: Spans on a time axis, like request timings or a trace.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: A sidebar layout that collapses to icons with Mod+B, remembers it, and becomes a drawer on narrow screens; with sidebar navigation.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Where you are, with the current page marked.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page header
items.description: A page title with description and actions.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A bordered block with header, title, description, content and footer.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short status label in five tones, readable in every skin, and a count badge for the corner of an icon or avatar.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A plain HTML table in a scroll area: sticky headings, a sticky first column, and rows that stack into labelled blocks on narrow screens.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code in its language's colors with a file name, line numbers, marked lines and a copy button; tabs for versions of the same code; and one command for npm, pnpm, yarn and bun that remembers the choice.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline edit
items.description: Text you edit where it shows: press it, Enter or F2 to edit, Enter to save, Escape to cancel, with validation and optional Save and Cancel buttons.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag input
items.description: Tags people type, paste or pick: a comma or Enter adds one, a pasted list becomes one tag each, and Enter or F2 edits a tag in place. No duplicates, a limit, your own rules with the reason shown, and agents add and remove tags by name.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone input
items.description: A phone number with a country picker: formatted as it's typed with the caret kept in place, a typed calling code chooses the country, any script's digits, left to right on any page, and the value in E.164. Agents set the number in any format and the country by name.

items.name: payments
items.title: Payments
items.description: How to pay and what it pays for: payment methods as cards to choose from, card fields whose security code follows the brand, a bank account by IBAN with its mandate, an order summary with a discount code and totals in the shop's currency, and a Pay button an agent can't press without a person.

items.name: address
items.title: Address
items.description: An address whose fields follow its country: the order it writes them in, its names for them (ZIP code, Eircode, Prefecture), the ones it requires, a list of regions where it has one, and its postal code's shape, from Google's address data for 252 countries. Autofill fills it; an agent fills it in one step by field name.

items.name: input-mask
items.title: Input mask
items.description: Fields formatted as they're typed with the caret kept in place: card numbers grouped by brand with the brand named, expiry dates and security codes, IBANs checked by country and checksum, amounts grouped in the locale, and patterns of your own. Each checks itself and reports its value without separators; agents set them in any format.

items.name: sortable-list
items.title: Sortable list
items.description: A list people put in order: drag an item by its grip, or pick it up with Space and move it with the arrows. Select several to move together, lock items in place, and let agents move items by name.

items.name: sortable-tree
items.title: Sortable tree
items.description: A tree people reorder and nest: drag a row up or down and sideways to change its level, or pick it up with Space and use the arrows. Only branches hold items, a drop elsewhere goes back and says why, and agents move items into branches by name.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number ticker
items.description: A number that moves to its new value, each skin its own way: Base rolls its digits, Blueprint counts, Studio steps, Phosphor types it, Ink redraws. It can count up once when first seen. People and agents read the value itself.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text reveal
items.description: Text that arrives a word or a letter at a time, each skin its own way, and reveals only what's new as a streamed answer grows. The whole text is in the page from the start, for screen readers and agents.

items.name: thinking
items.title: Thinking
items.description: A wait, each skin its own way: words that shimmer, moving hatching, an LED chase, printing dots, or still dots. A status, so screen readers hear it once.

items.name: crossfade
items.title: Crossfade
items.description: Content swapped in place, each skin its own way, while the box moves to the new content's size. The leaving content can't be reached or read.

items.name: schema-form
items.title: Schema form
items.description: A form from one definition: its fields with UISet's controls, steps with a review, checks as people type and on submit, and an agent that fills it by field name while a person approves the submit. The same definition is JSON Schema for an agent tool.

items.name: upload
items.title: Upload
items.description: A drop zone and a queue of uploads on UI SDK's File input: each file's preview, progress and status, with cancel, retry and remove, a few going up at a time, to whatever storage you use.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar group
items.description: Avatars stacked in a row, with a count of the ones that don't fit.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A number with its change, said in words as well as color, and an optional trend sparkline.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: What to do when there's nothing here yet.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholders, and a Loading region that announces once.

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description list
items.description: Terms and their details.

items.name: item-list
items.title: Item list
items.description: Rows with media, title, description, meta and actions.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline message in four tones that names its tone, interrupts only when urgent, and can be dismissed.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Keyboard key
items.description: Keys written the way this platform writes them.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A loading indicator that says what's loading.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Steps of a flow with the current one marked and later ones locked.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: A search box with a clear button and a key that focuses it from anywhere.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copies a value and says so.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data grid
items.description: A spreadsheet-grade grid on UI SDK: virtualized rows, sorting, filters, grouping, pinned, resizable and movable columns, row and cell selection, inline editing with validation, clipboard copy and paste, CSV export, a saved layout and agent actions.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: The frame every UISet chart shares: title, a legend that isolates series, a Chart/Table switch with the table twin, a keyboard listbox of data positions, tooltips, palettes validated for color blindness per skin, and agent actions.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line chart
items.description: Trends over time: one or more lines, a soft area for one series, or stacked areas, with a crosshair that lists every series and labels at line ends.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Categories compared: columns or horizontal bars, grouped or stacked, ranked, with thin marks and values at the tips.

items.name: scatter-chart
items.title: Scatter chart
items.description: Two measures per item, up to three groups, with hover that finds the nearest point.

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: Magnitude on a grid in one hue, with a scale and arrows that move by cell and by row.

items.name: segmented-bar
items.title: Segmented bar
items.description: One whole split into up to six parts, with shares printed where they fit: the readable answer to a donut.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A trend inside text, a table cell or a stat, whose name says where the values went. Works in Server Components.

items.name: board
items.title: Board
items.description: A kanban board on UI SDK createTransfer: one tab stop, arrows across cards and columns, Space to carry a card, drag with the pointer, column limits, add in place, a details dialog to edit, move or delete, filters, and agent actions.

items.name: canvas
items.title: Canvas
items.description: A node editor on UI SDK's canvas behaviors: pan and zoom, drag nodes or move them with Alt and arrows, spatial focus, Shift-drag box selection, wires drawn by pointer or with C and arrows, a minimap, zoom controls, a toolbar, an inspector, undo, and agent actions.

items.name: ide
items.title: IDE
items.description: A code editor's parts on UI SDK: a file tree on Tree with version control marks, New, Rename, Move and Delete, and files dragged into folders; editor tabs on Tabs; a code editor with syntax colors, indenting and problems; a command palette on Command; problems and a status bar.

items.name: mobile
items.title: Mobile
items.description: Phone app parts on UI SDK: rows that swipe aside to actions (createSwipeActions), wheel pickers and a time wheel (bindScrollPicker), bottom sheets and action sheets (Drawer), pull to refresh, an app bar and a tab bar.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: A terminal on UI SDK's input history and stick-to-bottom: ANSI colors kept readable in every skin, links, streaming commands with progress lines, Tab completion, Ctrl+C and Ctrl+L, built-in help, clear and history, and agent actions.

items.name: scheduler
items.title: Scheduler
items.description: Calendars on UI SDK createSpans: a week, a day or a room timeline where people draw, move and resize events with the pointer or arrows, overlapping events sharing lanes, a month view, a toolbar, an event dialog, and agent actions.

items.name: knob
items.title: Knob
items.description: A rotary control built as a UI SDK primitive: drag, arrow keys, log scales, double-click reset, agent actions.

items.name: patch-bay
items.title: Patch bay
items.description: Jacks and cables built on UI SDK createConnect: patch by drag, keyboard or agent.

items.name: fader
items.title: Fader
items.description: A vertical UI SDK slider with its label and readout.

items.name: level-meter
items.title: Level meter
items.description: A UI SDK meter drawn as an LED ladder.

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: A conversation built on UI SDK: thread that follows new messages, messages with avatars, actions and versions, suggestions, plans and a thinking shimmer.

items.name: chat-response
items.title: Chat response
items.description: Streaming markdown that repairs itself mid-stream and never renders raw HTML, with code blocks highlighted by skin colors.

items.name: chat-parts
items.title: Chat parts
items.description: Reasoning that opens while the model thinks, tool calls with status, input and output and Allow or Deny when one waits for approval, subagent runs with their own steps, checkpoints to restore, sources, citations and images.

items.name: chat-message-parts
items.title: Chat message parts
items.description: Draws a Vercel AI SDK message's parts with the chat kit: Markdown text that completes while it streams, reasoning, tool calls in every state with approvals, sources, files, a plan, checkpoints and subagent runs. No dependency on the ai package.

items.name: chat-composer
items.title: Chat composer
items.description: The message box: Enter to send, history with ArrowUp, slash commands and mentions, attachments by drop, paste or picker, a model picker, a usage meter, and the messages queued while the agent works.

items.name: chat-sidebar
items.title: Chat sidebar
items.description: A list of chats with rename and confirmed delete, and a floating assistant launcher.

items.name: rich-text
items.title: Rich text editor
items.description: A rich text editor on UI SDK with no editor library: headings, nested and numbered lists, to-dos, quotes, code, links, mentions, dividers and images; a toolbar, Markdown as you type, "/" for blocks and "@" for people (TriggerMenu); safe paste from documents and the web; undo; Markdown and clean HTML out; agents read and write Markdown.

items.name: agent-console
items.title: Agent Console
items.description: The human side of the UI SDK agent bridge: approvals in your app, an activity feed with undo, highlights where the agent changed something, a thread and a prompt.

items.name: step-sequencer
items.title: Step sequencer
items.description: A row of steps built on UI SDK ToggleGroup, with downbeats and a playhead.

items.name: auth
items.title: Auth pages
items.description: Sign in, sign up, forgot and reset password, and verify a code: native validation, server messages, autocomplete hints and a password strength meter.

items.name: dashboard
items.title: Dashboard page
items.description: A date range that scopes everything: figures with trends, revenue, orders by channel, plan mix and recent orders.

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings page
items.description: Profile, security and sessions, notifications, billing with usage and invoices, team with invites and removal, and a danger zone.

items.name: admin
items.title: Admin records page
items.description: A records list with search, filters, columns and export; create and edit in a drawer; inline edits; confirmed bulk delete; an empty state.

items.name: inbox
items.title: Inbox page
items.description: Mail in three panes: folders, a message list you arrow through, the message with star, archive and delete, and compose.

items.name: chat-app
items.title: Chat app page
items.description: The chat kit as a product: chats, a thread and a composer, with your model plugged in as an async stream of events.

items.name: ide-app
items.title: IDE page
items.description: A code editor in resizable panes: files with version control marks, tabs, an editor with syntax colors, a command palette (files, commands, lines), problems, an outline and a status bar.

items.name: project-board
items.title: Project board page
items.description: A project's issues as a board or a list: sprint progress, search and an assignee filter, column limits, card details, a new-issue form and Undo on moves.

items.name: calendar-app
items.title: Calendar page
items.description: A calendar app: day, week and month views, a small month to jump to a day, calendars to show or hide, what's next, and events created, edited and deleted in a dialog.

items.name: checkout
items.title: Checkout page
items.description: A checkout: contact, a delivery address whose fields follow its country, delivery options, card or bank payment with a billing address when it differs, and the order with a discount code and Pay beside it. Pay checks the whole page and focuses the first problem; an agent fills it and a person pays.

items.name: invoice
items.title: Invoice page
items.description: An invoice: who it's from and to (each address as its country writes it), its dates and status, the lines with tax and total in its currency, how to pay by bank transfer with the IBAN and reference to copy, and notes. It prints clean.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing section
items.description: Plans with a monthly or yearly switch, a recommended plan, a comparison table and questions.

items.name: agent-check
items.title: Agent readiness check
items.description: Checks whether an agent can use a page: every control named, each name finding one control, and none that only looks clickable, with a score. Through a UI SDK app's agent bridge, or by reading any site's accessibility tree. In a test (expectAgentReady, expectPageReady), on a page in Playwright, from the command line, or drawn over the page (showAgentReadiness).
